goal: Make every later change measurable and reversible
attempt: git init, .gitignore for data/secrets, first commit, tag baseline-handwritten, branch automation; tools/quality_gate.py runs the official check.py, radon MI, tests, purity, time
diagnosis: without a gate an "improvement" cannot be told from a regression
fix: one command for all gates, a JSON baseline, a jsonl history of runs
result: every later step ends with the same gate
lesson: build the measuring instrument before touching the code

goal: Know what is a convention and what is specification
attempt: inventory of my_solution: every hidden choice (hole A), spec rule (B), framework (C), with place, alternatives, evidence
observation: 72 holes: 30 easy, 28 medium, 10 hard, 4 without data
diagnosis: the automation target is the holes only; spec and framework stay code
fix: docs/holes.md
lesson: classify before automating

goal: A failing policy must not fail a whole task
attempt: guard.per_policy: catch per policy, report on stderr; a robustness test on a damaged copy
observation: test RED, then GREEN; 0 policies skipped on train
diagnosis: one malformed private policy could zero a task
fix: gate fails if any train policy is skipped
lesson: robustness as a gate, counted, not silent

goal: Explain the 3 t4 rows wrong by one cent
attempt: hypotheses: rounding in the month of the conversion; leap years
observation: neither reproduced the cents
diagnosis: the risk charge base was valued again after the other charges; the split rest could be negative
fix: two general rules: risk on slot values before charges less admin and management parts; split rest never negative
result: t4 34,121 -> 34,124 of 34,145, no other row changed
lesson: prefer one general rule over special cases; reject hypotheses by data

goal: One dictionary of conventions and a generator of rules.py
attempt: conventions.py gathers the families of bricks; autosolve.py searches and writes rules.py deterministically
observation: t0: money date, rounding; the README claim "half up before 2007" was not supported by data (no third decimal >= 5 before 2007)
diagnosis: a tie presented as a finding
fix: mark ties as "not distinguishable on train" with the principle used
lesson: separate evidence from choice by principle

goal: Find the era (COBOL -> Neuron NG) automatically
attempt: rank single rules, diagnose the misses with a one-level tree, cut on a date, snap the cut to a landmark (a day with all events of one kind)
observation: cut near 2007-08-11, snapped onto the day of all 946 events 800
diagnosis: the change point is a business event, not a statistical cut
fix: landmarks from NREVNT; pairs (COBOL, NG) for era holes
lesson: snap statistical cuts to business landmarks

attempt: git add of a deleted file failed silently in a chained command
observation: a commit missed files
diagnosis: chained shell commands hide a failing step
fix: separate commit; check a clean worktree before every merge
lesson: verify `git status --porcelain` is empty before merging

attempt: search past items, anchor day, origin, month step
observation: no existing anchor family fitted drifted schedules (31st -> 28th in COBOL years)
diagnosis: the dictionary lacked a convention
fix: new family: highest day of the last 12 due dates
lesson: when no option fits, the dictionary is incomplete, not the data noisy

goal: t2 offer: 14 holes with an exponential number of combinations
attempt: coordinate descent from the simplest options
observation: stuck at an infeasible start (application date)
diagnosis: single moves cannot leave a valley where two holes must change together
fix: pair moves when stuck below 99 %
lesson: coordinate search needs pair moves for coupled holes

goal: A tie: charge may go below zero or stop at zero
attempt: both options match every train row
observation: no evidence on train
diagnosis: principle: consistency with the same rule elsewhere (t3 never goes below zero)
fix: choose "never below zero", noted
result: tie settled by a stated principle
lesson: ties need a written principle, not a silent default

attempt: descent on a 3 % sample of policies
observation: several holes tied on the sample
diagnosis: step-2 rules only won by family order on the sample
fix: escalate ties to a full replay of all train policies (case.confirm)
result: admin cap +1 row, risk base +2, split rest +3 decided on 1,077,102 totals
lesson: a sample tie is not a data tie: escalate

attempt: era case needs the risk rate, found later in t3
observation: import/order deadlock
diagnosis: mutual dependency of searches
fix: ASSUMES: a case states the option it assumes; autosolve checks at the end that the later search found the same
lesson: make assumptions explicit and checked

attempt: work cut off by a usage limit with uncommitted changes
observation: work in tree, not committed
diagnosis: long steps without commits
fix: progress note commit; later: commit before experiments
lesson: commit before every experiment

attempt: gate time above limit
observation: machine load (other apps, load avg 64), not the code
diagnosis: measured a CPU benchmark to separate load from regressions
fix: cache rate_and_price, skip zero pieces
lesson: benchmark the machine before blaming the code

attempt: adding search plumbing lowered MI to 92.6, 92.2, 90.2 several times
observation: radon MI falls with log(lines) and log(Halstead volume) and rises with comment share (optimum ~57 %)
diagnosis: big modules and one-line docstrings
fix: small topic modules with multi-line evidence docstrings
lesson: MI is a module-size metric: keep modules small and documented

goal: LLM proposes missing bricks (ablation: no Easter holidays)
attempt: Qwen 27B asked when a part stays unexplained
observation: first run: 0 bricks kept
diagnosis: sandbox rejected helper names with "_"; model added Good Friday (not a Ticino holiday); empty answers when reasoning used all tokens
fix: sandbox forbids only dunders; prompt shows exact rows near the misses; retry with low effort on empty answers
result: 94 % -> 100 % in one step; COBOL age rule rediscovered
lesson: show the model what must stay right, not only what is wrong

goal: Random date splits before asking the model
attempt: tree split on due date < 2027-03-27 (Easter 2027)
observation: the LLM saw only a fragment
diagnosis: statistical cuts at non-business dates hide the real rule
fix: plausible(): split only on landmark/parameter/Jan-1 dates, else ask the model first
result: one brick explains the whole part
lesson: defer implausible splits

attempt: automated security review after commit
observation: AST filter allowed gi_frame.f_back.f_globals, str.format with {0.__class__}, module objects
diagnosis: filter incomplete
fix: block underscore attributes, frame/code attributes, format, dunder texts; pass only date/timedelta/datetime
lesson: a syntax filter is a guard, not a sandbox; say so

goal: Ablation without the t1 anchor day
attempt: remove the anchor brick
observation: best rule 99.95 % counted as explained; LLM never asked
diagnosis: the "explained" threshold (99.9 %) hides small dictionary gaps
fix: documented as a limit
lesson: report what the engine cannot see

goal: Which date decides the era of each calculation
attempt: candidates: application, money, trade, charge, valuation; score per-era rules on each
observation: offer: application date (8 rows decide); charges: charge date (14,838 rows); others ties
diagnosis: needed per rule, not one global date
fix: ERA_DATE per case; ties go to the day of the calculation itself
result: 65 of 72 holes; search of t3 charges 145 -> 322 s
lesson: make even the "date of the era" a hole

goal: Figures must not show target values
attempt: waterfall title said "differs"
observation: Decimal("2220") compared with the string "2220.00"
diagnosis: string comparison of numbers
fix: compare Decimals; later draw only our values of a public policy
lesson: compare numbers as numbers

goal: No target value anywhere in git
attempt: scan: values of a policy next to its id, values after "expected"
observation: outliers.csv, saved prompts, a docstring example with real values
diagnosis: reports and prompts carried target rows
fix: delete/ignore outliers.csv, redact prompts, tools/target_leaks.py in the gate
lesson: scan the whole repo, not only the solution

attempt: run the team build v22 on our extract; vary each switch; count changed rows
observation: base of untaxed CH 56 % of rows; BOL base switch 24 % of annual rows
diagnosis: the leaderboard (20 rows, noise +-2) only sees changes of large groups
fix: plan submissions by group size
lesson: estimate what a 20-row oracle can detect before spending submissions

goal: Port v22 into the Hack style
attempt: rewrite 18 modules as plain Python with switches in rules.py
observation: output = v22 on 0 of 2,493 and 0 of 6,381 rows differing
diagnosis: n/a
fix: equivalence test against the reference outputs outside git
lesson: port with a byte-exact reference check

goal: autosolve with a case without check.py task
attempt: full run
observation: crash at the end: case has no TASK
diagnosis: check.py does not know t7
fix: skip cases without TASK in the final check
lesson: test the tail of long pipelines on a tiny case first

observation: tax modules of 20-60 lines with 10-30 % comments
diagnosis: module size and comment share
fix: 35 small modules, multi-line evidence docstrings
lesson: measure per file and fix the worst first

attempt: wrote "no payout is both HEV and TFS"
observation: counted: 3 payouts are
diagnosis: unverified claim
fix: corrected the text
result: claims in docs are checked by counts
lesson: never write a number you did not count

goal: Rules of which payouts carry a tax, from NRTAXB
attempt: decision tree per tax on booked/not booked
observation: KST explained by the feature "KST booked"
diagnosis: target leaked into the features
fix: a tax never sees itself; only dependent taxes (SOL, KIS) see their base tax
lesson: check every feature for target leakage

goal: Leaderboard probe: base 0 for untaxed CH; reported VST rows
attempt: upload
observation: payout 1/20, annual 15/20: identical to v22, same 20 rows
diagnosis: the base was not the cause; something common to untaxed rows was
fix: look at format
lesson: an unchanged score is information

goal: Leaderboard probe: empty text instead of None for the remittance date
attempt: upload (built by Nazar)
diagnosis: the scorer dropped every row with None as malformed (date converter)
fix: '' kept; official scoring_t7 later confirmed None and '' read alike
lesson: check how the scorer parses every column type

attempt: naive merge of 82 modules into 21
diagnosis: merging costs ~12.5*ln(n) MI points per module
fix: greedy merge plan within themes minimizing MI loss
lesson: quantify the metric cost before restructuring

attempt: merged the tables hub
observation: circular import (hub imports a module that imports the hub)
diagnosis: hub semantics
fix: keep hubs; reject merges that create an import cycle
lesson: check the import graph is acyclic after merges

attempt: regex renamed `dates.` (module merged) everywhere
observation: t3 0 % (a local variable `dates.append` renamed)
diagnosis: textual rename hit a local variable with the same name as a module
fix: rename `X.` only in files that `import X`
lesson: rename by imports, not by text

attempt: git checkout -- to revert a failed merge
observation: reverted an uncommitted earlier task too
diagnosis: experiment without a commit
fix: redid the task and committed it as WIP first
lesson: commit before every experiment

attempt: no plan reaches 93.2 at <= 95 files
diagnosis: structural limit of the metric
fix: Nazar decided: floor 89.2, gate also checks <= 100 files
lesson: ask the owner when a constraint conflicts with a metric

goal: t7 took 93 s on the server
attempt: profile
observation: 30 of 38 s: a replay of all 4,011 policies for year-end values; NRBOOK read twice
diagnosis: replay of policies without a yearly stamp duty
fix: replay only the 672 policies with one; read NRBOOK once for t3 and t7
lesson: profile, then cut the work, not the precision

attempt: A1 payout net of the surrender penalty; A2 shares to the cent; B1 stamp duty on the surrender value; B2 weekend shift
observation: NRTAXB contradictions CH 2->0, IT 5->0; fractions of a cent 74->0
diagnosis: gross amount and exact shares were wrong
fix: switches T7_PAYOUT_AMOUNT, T7_BASIS_SHARE; official scoring checks in the gate
lesson: use internal consistency (presence of bookings) as a target when amounts are hidden

attempt: switches appended to old modules
diagnosis: bigger modules
fix: three small new modules (98 files)
lesson: add new code in small modules

attempt: eras.conversion_day: the day of the events 800 of the extract, else rules.py
observation: our output identical; L2 client 94-100 % before any search
diagnosis: the cut-off was a constant of our extract
fix: adopt the cut-off per extract at every entry point
lesson: read per-extract facts at run time

attempt: run on client legacy and targets copies
observation: crash: no date split; then the best single rule fitted 0 % of the offers
diagnosis: another column split first; the era case fixed growth and management rate
fix: date-only diagnosis; widen the era case with growth and pot when its fixed options fit < 50 %
lesson: fixed parts of a finder must become holes when they fail

attempt: gh repo view; git push over https
observation: blocked by the auto-mode classifier; no credentials
diagnosis: environment, not code
fix: local checks only; gh auth setup-git after the user logged in
lesson: stop and explain when a permission blocks
